title: Singapore Primary Mathematics Syllabus 2021 Dataset (P1-P6)
description: Machine-readable dataset of the MOE 2021 Primary Mathematics Syllabus (Primary One to Six), Standard Mathematics syllabus, updated October 2025. 202 learning points across the three content strands (Number and Algebra; Measurement and Geometry; Statistics): learning area, sub-strand, topic, official item code and learning-point text, each with a page-level source reference into the official document. Independently compiled from MOE's official PDF and manually verified row-by-row. Not produced, endorsed or approved by MOE - the official document prevails. Licensed CC BY-NC 4.0.
